items.title: Want $7,000 in Passive Income? Buy These 3 Dividend Stocks Today
items.summary: Selling shares to pay the bills can wreck a retirement portfolio in a downturn. A biotech giant, a Coca-Cola bottler, and a Kansas utility offer another route, though one of them carries a payout ratio above its own target.

items.title: Iron Mountain Raises Its Dividend 15% as Data Center Revenue Surges 34%
items.summary: A company famous for storing paper boxes now funds its shareholder payouts with server halls. Income investors should weigh how Iron Mountain stacks up against Digital Realty and Equinix, and which balance sheet figure could complicate the story.

items.title: Evergy vs. Otter Tail: Which Utility Dividend Is Safer for Retirement?
items.summary: One utility just raised its payout and its outlook while the other missed earnings and watched its stock slide. But Otter Tail wins some of the numbers retirees care about most, so the safer dividend is not as obvious as it looks.
